subject: Action required: HarborTech invite not attaching to vendor record — PO hold
messages:
From: Ellie Park <ellie@harbortech.io>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: HarborTech Procurement <procurement@harbortech.io>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 13:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor portal invite — HarborTech (PO 4592)

Hi Rafael,

We followed the invite link you sent yesterday but it created a brand-new HarborTech vendor profile instead of attaching to the existing HarborTech Inc. account. Procurement has the PO sitting on hold until the vendor record is correct.

I attached a screenshot of the acceptance page (invite-screenshot.png) and the PO we referenced (harbortech-PO4592.pdf). Our IT team says we aren't seeing any obvious errors on our side.

Quick details: we received the invite via an internal forwarding rule (someone forwarded from personal email to procurement@harbortech.io), then clicked the link from the forwarded message inside our web proxy-managed browser.

Can your team reissue the invite or force-link the account so we can proceed? We have a compliance deadline this Friday.

Thanks,
Ellie Park
Vendor Ops — HarborTech Inc.
ellie@harbortech.io
(415) 555-0112
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie@harbortech.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 13:28:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor portal invite — HarborTech (PO 4592)

Hi Ellie — thanks for the quick note and the attachments. Sorry you're blocked; we know how painful a PO hold is.

Looping in Ben (sales) and Monica (CS) so we can coordinate the customer-visible steps and the backend fix. Ben/Monica — can you help prioritize? For engineering, I opened JIRA-INVITE-6621 and added the screenshots.

Ellie, two quick asks to triage:
- Can you try the original invite email (not the forwarded copy) in an incognito/private window and tell me whether it attaches correctly?
- If it still mis-attaches, can you paste the full final redirect URL you land on (the browser address bar) and confirm whether the link has extra query params added by your proxy (we've seen internal proxies rewrite headers/params before).

If you prefer, I can reissue a new invite token and mark the vendor manually to the HarborTech account while we debug.

I'll have engineering look at logs for the invite token and redirect chain once you confirm the test.

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Partner Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellie Park <ellie@harbortech.io>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 13:52:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor portal invite — HarborTech (PO 4592)

Thanks — quick tech note from my side before we escalate to platform: we have seen forwarded invites occasionally lose the Authorization: Bearer header on the POST that finalizes the "attach to tenant" flow — typically when a corporate proxy rewraps requests. That can cause our onboarding service to create a new shadow vendor instead of linking the existing vendor id.

If Ellie can confirm that incognito works, we'll proceed with a manual reattach for PO-4592 and reissue an invite that includes a one-time-checksum param to avoid proxy rewriting. If incognito fails, please include the redirect chain (the full URLs) and I'll grab relevant request ids from logs.

I'm attaching a tiny example log snippet we use for this class of failures (no PII) — internal only.

Ben Carter
Director, Sales Engineering
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Ellie Park <ellie@harbortech.io>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: HarborTech Procurement <procurement@harbortech.io>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor portal invite — HarborTech (PO 4592)

Hi all — I just tried the original invite in an incognito window and it attached correctly to our existing HarborTech vendor record. The forwarded copy is the one that creates a new profile.

Our security team confirmed the corporate web proxy rewrites Authorization headers on POSTs that originate from forwarded messages. They suggested sending the invite to procurement@harbortech.io directly from your domain (not forwarded from external personal accounts) or provide a short-lived tokenized link that survives the proxy rewrite.

We really appreciate the quick turnaround — can you reissue to procurement@harbortech.io and flag the vendor so our PO can be released? ETA would help procurement.

Ellie
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie@harbortech.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor portal invite — HarborTech (PO 4592)

Thanks for confirming, Ellie — great troubleshooting.

Plan of record:
- I will reissue a new invite targeted to procurement@harbortech.io (not forwarded) within the hour and include the one-time checksum param Ben mentioned.
- Monica, can your team mark the vendor record manually to HarborTech Inc. so procurement can push PO-4592 through now?
- Engineering (JIRA-INVITE-6621) will add a proxy-resilience check to token finalization logic; target rollout in ~48 hours.

Monica: if you confirm the manual attach, I'll reply-all with the cleared PO note so procurement can proceed.

Ellie: attaching the reissued invite now (sent) — if procurement still sees a problem please reply and we'll hop on a quick call.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Partner Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
